about.heading: Who is Clara Malcriada?
bio: Clara Malcriada was born somewhere between a botched scolding and a comeback delivered behind someone's back. She showed a gift for saying what she thinks from an early age — especially when nobody asked. At 7, she said "I don't have to" for the first time, and never stopped.

With a degree in Applied Sarcasm Arts and a specialization in Passive-Aggressive Communication, Clara built a career turning everyday situations into verbal weapons of moderate (emotional) destruction. She rose to fame after being kicked out of three family WhatsApp groups — with honors and zero regrets.

specialties.text: Declines invitations with elegance, gives unsolicited advice, and replies to emails with "as requested" even when nobody requested anything.

about.lead: Clara Malcriada is a Brazilian author of sarcastic books on insults, irony and elegant verbal comebacks. Her work explores how different cultures — from imperial China to the Russia of the tsars, from the Arab world to the Persia of the poets — turned criticism into a literary genre. All titles are available on Amazon in Kindle format, and most are free to read with a Kindle Unlimited subscription.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: How this site collects, uses and protects your data — in plain English.

privacy.intro: This policy explains how the Clara Malcriada website collects, uses and protects visitors' personal data.

sections.heading: 1. Data we collect
paragraphs: We collect only the email address you type into the newsletter form. The form is processed by Formspree, a service that receives and forwards the message — no other personal data is requested or stored by this site.

sections.heading: 2. How we use data
paragraphs: Email addresses are used exclusively to send the newsletter (news, new releases and promotions). We do not sell, rent or share your data with third parties, except Formspree, which acts only as the technical processor of the form.

sections.heading: 3. Consent
paragraphs: By subscribing to the newsletter, you agree to the storage and use of your email for the purposes described above. You can unsubscribe at any time via the unsubscribe link included in every email, or by writing to the official contact channel.

sections.heading: 4. Your rights
paragraphs: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time — just send an email to the contact channel listed on this site. We answer requests within 30 days.

sections.heading: 5. Affiliate links
paragraphs: This site participates in the Amazon affiliate program. Purchase links may record browsing data (such as cookies) for sales attribution, without identifying who you are. Amazon has its own privacy policy, which governs everything that happens there.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in our practices. Significant changes will be announced on this same page and, when relevant, by email to newsletter subscribers.

items.a: Clara Malcriada is a Brazilian author of sarcastic books on insults, irony and elegant verbal comebacks, published in Kindle format on Amazon. She is the creator of The Art of Insults series.

items.q: Where can I buy Clara Malcriada's books?
items.a: All titles are available on Amazon in Kindle format, and most are included in the Kindle Unlimited program. Buy links are on this page and on the site's home page.

items.q: What is the reading order of The Art of Insults series?
items.a: The volumes (Chinese Indirection, Russian Insults, Arabic Insults and Persian Insult) are independent and can be read in any order. Suggested order: Chinese, Russian, Arabic, Persian.

items.q: Are the books available in English?
items.a: Yes. The main titles are published in English editions on Amazon.com, in addition to the original Brazilian Portuguese editions.

items.q: Do I need a Kindle device to read the books?
items.a: No. Any Kindle e-reader or the free Kindle app for phone, tablet or computer works. With a Kindle Unlimited subscription, most titles can be read at no extra cost.

items.q: How can I contact the author?
items.a: Through the official channels listed on this page: email, X (Twitter), Instagram and the Amazon author page.
